title: Han Solo
description: As a teenager on the streets of Corellia, Han Solo was a street thief scratching out a living working for Lady Proxima and the White Worms until he double-crossed her for a vial of coaxium. An itinerant scoundrel, thief, and conman, Han Solo lived a life of crime, always looking for the next big score and relying on his trusty sidekick and first mate, Chewbacca the Wookiee for companionship. Cruising the galaxy in the Millennium Falcon, his life would change abruptly when he met an old Jedi, a farm boy, and a pair of Droids on Tatooine.
